# Decks.com

> > Comprehensive deck building and design resource featuring Trex composite decking products, construction guides, and outdoor living inspiration.

Decks.com provides detailed tutorials on deck construction, framing techniques, railing systems, and outdoor living spaces. The site emphasizes Trex composite materials and includes cost guides, permit requirements, and design inspiration for homeowners and contractors.

## Key Topics

- Trex composite decking
- Deck construction and framing
- Outdoor living spaces
- Deck design inspiration
- Railing systems (cable, composite, hog wire)
- Building codes and permits
- Deck repair and maintenance
- Joist framing and ledger boards
- Outdoor dining and entertaining
- Pool decks and patios
- Trex Transcend and Signature products
- Deck lighting installation
- Post wraps and finishing
- Curb appeal enhancement
- Gazebos and shade structures

## Getting Started & Planning

- [Deck Ideas & Inspiration Hub | Explore Projects, Guides & More](https://www.decks.com/ideas): Main inspiration hub with project gallery, design guides, and Trex decks
- [Do You Need a Permit To Build a Deck?](https://www.decks.com/resource-index/decking/deck-permit-site-plans): Deck permit requirements, building codes, and zoning regulations guide
- [How to Find & Choose a Deck Contractor](https://www.decks.com/resource-index/decking/how-to-find-choose-a-deck-contractor): Contractor selection guide covering credentials and insurance vetting
- [When to Repair vs Replace Your Deck (2025 Costs)](https://www.decks.com/resource-index/decking/deck-replacement-and-repair-costs): 2025 deck repair vs replacement cost comparison and decision guide

## Deck Construction & Building Guides

- [How to Build a Raised Deck](https://www.decks.com/resource-index/decking/how-to-build-a-raised-deck): Step-by-step guide for building elevated decks above ground level
- [Framing an Octagon Deck](https://www.decks.com/resource-index/decking/how-to-build-an-octagon-deck): Tutorial for framing octagon-shaped decks and gazebo foundations
- [Installing a Deck Ledger Board Around Vents, Pipes and Spigots](https://www.decks.com/resource-index/framing/installing-a-deck-ledger-board-around-vents-pipes-and-spigots): Guide to installing ledger boards around obstacles like vents and pipes
- [Rotted Deck Joists: Prevent & Repair Joist Rot](https://www.decks.com/resource-index/framing/how-to-avoid-prevent-repair-deck-joist-rot): Prevention and repair guide for deck joist rot with maintenance tips

## Railing Design & Installation

- [11 Front Porch Railing Ideas & Designs](https://www.decks.com/resource-index/railing/front-porch-railing-ideas): Front porch railing design ideas featuring Trex & cable railing styles
- [Hog Wire Deck Railing Ideas, Tips, & Design Inspiration](https://www.decks.com/resource-index/railing/guide-to-hog-wire-deck-railings): Hog wire railing design guide featuring Trex Signature & Select Mesh

## Design Inspiration & Ideas

- [Pool Deck Ideas: Get Inspired and Make a Splash in Your Backyard](https://www.decks.com/ideas/deck-inspiration/pool-deck): Pool deck design inspiration gallery with shape and material ideas
- [Backyard Patio Ideas and Inspiration for 2026](https://www.decks.com/resource-index/porches-patios/backyard-patio-ideas-and-inspiration): Patio design ideas covering concrete, brick & various outdoor materials
- [Beautiful Two-Toned Deck Ideas and Colors](https://www.decks.com/resource-index/decking/two-toned-deck-ideas-and-pictures): Two-toned deck color combinations featuring Trex composite decking
- [12 Best Outdoor Gazebo Ideas](https://www.decks.com/resource-index/shade-privacy/gazebo-ideas): Gazebo design ideas for poolside, outdoor office, and entertaining

## Finishing & Accessories

- [Installing Deck Post Wraps and Sleeves](https://www.decks.com/resource-index/decking/how-to-install-deck-post-wraps-and-sleeves): Installation guide for composite, vinyl, and aluminum post wraps
- [Installing Recessed Stair Lighting on Your Deck](https://www.decks.com/resource-index/lighting/how-to-install-recessed-stair-lighting): Low-voltage recessed stair lighting installation per IRC code R314.7
- [Best Deck Paint Options for 2026](https://www.decks.com/resource-index/decking/best-deck-paint): Deck paint reviews including KILZ Enamel and Fixall anti-slip options

## Outdoor Living & Entertainment

- [Best Outdoor Dining Room Ideas For 2026](https://www.decks.com/resource-index/lifestyle/best-outdoor-dining-room-ideas): Outdoor dining area ideas with pergola, gazebo, and patio designs
- [Best Outdoor Patio Tables](https://www.decks.com/resource-index/lifestyle/best-patio-tables): Outdoor table reviews featuring Trex Furniture and POLYWOOD products
- [5 Ways to Use Your Deck In The Winter](https://www.decks.com/resource-index/decking/5-ways-to-use-your-deck-in-the-winter): Winter deck usage tips featuring Trex composite and DeckProtect heating
